items.text: Develop Multimodal Human Interfaces: Design and deploy real-time teleoperation frameworks, VR/XR environments, and haptic feedback systems (e.g., haptic gloves, wearable tracking) for high-fidelity control of dexterous robotic hands and arms.

Build Multimodal Data Pipelines: Architect time-synchronized, multi-sensor data collection infrastructure that logs vision, joint states, tactile array feedback, and force/torque signatures during physical interaction.

Implement Shared Autonomy & Human-in-the-Loop Refinement: Develop shared control algorithms and low-code/intuitive teaching interfaces that allow operators to intervene, correct, or refine robot actions in real time.
User-Centric Evaluation: Conduct systematic human-in-the-loop user studies to quantify operator cognitive load, ergonomic efficiency, and interface responsiveness.
Sim-to-Real Hardware Validation: Integrate operator teleoperation interfaces across high-fidelity physics engines (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) and physical multi-bimanual testbeds.

description.text:
The Delta Robotics Innovation Center (DRIC) is established to support Delta Electronics’ long-term robotics development. Its primary purpose is to build and enhance Delta’s capabilities in robot design, manufacturing, and integration. Rather than focusing on delivering specific products, the center aims to cultivate core competencies that enable Delta groups to efficiently develop and commercialize robotics-based solutions. We are seeking an HRI Engineer to design next-generation human interfaces for dexterous robotic manipulation and architect robust, multimodal interaction data systems. You will develop intuitive teleoperation tools—including VR/XR environments, haptic gloves, and vision-based tracking—to enable humans to seamlessly guide, teach, and collaborate with complex robotic end-effectors.
Responsibilities:
• Develop Multimodal Human Interfaces: Design and deploy real-time teleoperation frameworks, VR/XR environments, and haptic feedback systems (e.g., haptic gloves, wearable tracking) for high-fidelity control of dexterous robotic hands and arms.
• Build Multimodal Data Pipelines: Architect time-synchronized, multi-sensor data collection infrastructure that logs vision, joint states, tactile array feedback, and force/torque signatures during physical interaction.
•Implement Shared Autonomy & Human-in-the-Loop Refinement: Develop shared control algorithms and low-code/intuitive teaching interfaces that allow operators to intervene, correct, or refine robot actions in real time.
•User-Centric Evaluation: Conduct systematic human-in-the-loop user studies to quantify operator cognitive load, ergonomic efficiency, and interface responsiveness.
• Sim-to-Real Hardware Validation: Integrate operator teleoperation interfaces across high-fidelity physics engines (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) and physical multi-bimanual testbeds.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Requirements
•Core Software & Middleware: High proficiency in C++ and Python, with hands-on experience in ROS/ROS2 and real-time data streaming architectures.
•Teleoperation & Kinematic Mapping: Proven experience building real-time teleoperation loops, including custom joint-action mapping or spatial 6DoF tracking.
•Multimodal Data Systems: Experience designing or working with data systems that manage tightly synchronized multimodal robotic data, including vision, tactile and force sensor telemetry, teleoperation trajectories, and robot state logs.
•Haptics & Shared Control: Knowledge of integrating force/tactile feedback loops, haptic cues, or human-in-the-loop policy refinement into control systems.
•Plus: Human-in-the-loop user study design, familiarity with low-code/Behavior Tree task modeling, or publications in top robotics/HRI venues (HRI, CoRL, ICRA, IROS).
Design Human-Robot Interfaces: Develop intuitive, real-time multimodal interfaces (such as VR/AR headsets, haptic gloves, and vision-based tracking) to map human hand kinematics directly to complex, multi-fingered robotic hands.
